messages:
Maya: FYI CrescentAI dropped off last week. Advocate moved and procurement says they're vetting VendorX. Need quick triage.
Jon: Got it. Any numbers?
Maya: Dashboard snapshot: Last 7d tokens 25k, Prev 7d 131k. /generate and /embeddings biggest drops. Active seats 8->5.
Sam: Likely causes: champion left, procurement cost check, plus a couple of latency spikes on long sequences. I can pull two timed-out traces.
Priya: Open onboarding items: SSO test, KV cache tuning, batch window config. I flagged infra ticket yesterday.
Jon: Rescue plan suggestion: 30d no-commit dedicated trial for embeds, small credit for lost week, 30m call with new PM.
Maya: They want an ROI slide for procurement comparing costs vs VendorX. Sam, can you estimate token cost delta?
Sam: From logs avg seq len ~850 tokens, QPS ~0.6 BH. With our batching+KV ~ $0.0036/token-equivalent; VendorX public ~ $0.0055/token. Roughly 20% higher spend if they move. I'll prepare a short chart.
OpsBot: Alert: usage drop >60% and advocate change. Playbook: rescue outreach.
Maya: Actions: Jon -> ROI slide; Priya -> confirm infra for temporary dedicated pool; Sam -> traces + 2-line remediation (KV tune + quant profile); Maya -> outreach + meeting invite.
Jon: One-pager by EOD. Can also propose a demo to fix a slow query <30s.
Priya: Infra check green for a small 1-week pool starting Monday if we get approvals.
Sam: Traces + remediation note ready before sync.
Maya: Sync 11:30 PT tomorrow. I'll loop in new PM and procurement if we have ROI + infra confirm.
Jon: +1.
Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
